posts.title: 2025 roundup
posts.description: Here's some stuff I did last year. Pixelrings : LED earrings programmable in Python. RP2040-RS232 : RS-232 adapter with an RP2040 chip. Can be used to adapt ancient serial mice or 3D mice for modern systems or as a generic serial-to-USB adapter.
